name: origami
description: Variable-resolution context: folds bulky stale tool output to disk behind always-visible stubs; hydrate() recovers detail on demand.

foldAgeTurns.title: Fold age (turns)
foldAgeTurns.description: Results younger than this many turns are never fold candidates

minFoldMass.title: Min fold mass (tokens)
minFoldMass.description: Candidate token mass that triggers a sweep

workingSetBudget.title: Working set budget (tokens)
workingSetBudget.description: Absolute live-context tokens; above it sweeps turn aggressive

minReductionRatio.title: Min reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Below this estimated reduction a sweep is skipped

pinAfterHydrations.title: Pin after hydrations
pinAfterHydrations.description: Hydration count at which a fold is pinned open
